ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 65% low-intensity (black) pixels to 35% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black central region; distinct white distal patches on both lobes. The right distal white patch contains three discrete, high-contrast dark circular focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth of roughly 20% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with increased pixel-amplitude and frequency on the outer third of both lobes compared to the smoother regions near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast clusters of brown/white pixels (barnacle colonies) on the extreme lateral tips; dark circular pixel clusters on the distal white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) of varying lengths distributed across the central dark pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation on the distal tips of both lobes and multiple healed linear scrape marks in the central black region.
other_distinctive_markers: Characteristic triplet of dark circular pigmentation spots isolated on the white field of the distal right lobe.
